title: Papa's Snoring Band | Funny Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
Papa falls asleep on the sofa, and his loud snores become the best drum band ever!
This fun song teaches kids about taking turns, being quiet when someone needs rest, and how a little silliness can make everyone smile.
Sing along and tap your hands to the snore, snore, drum, drum beat!

Papa's on the sofa, sleeping
snore, snore, like a drum
zzz, zzz, big snore, big snore
shh, shh, Papa's asleep!

Snore, snore, drum, drum
boom, boom, boom, a silly band
snore snore drum, boom boom band
Papa's band is grand!

The snore is so loud, the cat jumps
up on the chair, meow, meow
snore, snore, snore, snore! the cat's tail puffs up
Oh no! Off the cat goes!

Snore, snore, drum, drum
boom, boom, boom, a silly band
snore snore drum, boom boom band
Papa's band is grand!

The kids play soft, shh, shh
tiptoe, tiptoe to the rug
Papa needs rest, rest, rest
quiet, quiet, quiet bug!

Snore, snore, drum, drum
boom, boom, boom, a silly band
snore snore drum, boom boom band
Papa's band is grand!

Papa wakes up with a yawn
"Hello, band! Let's play!" he sings
drum, drum, boom, boom, boom
Papa's band, hip hip hooray!
